fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-27 11:30 to 2026-11-28 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: none new. The two escalations of the last report (3a43fd0f Blueprint cardinality range form, f0c64ba4 dataModelRevision error codes) are now ratified in the group log, so nothing waits on you from the group's own stops. No escalation was filed this cycle.

2. Decided within mandate: no decision was ratified this cycle and no session was held. Proposed and still pending: 7ee9eaf7 (huge unknown integers in a registry are refused, not rounded; its PR srs-rust#1716 is open, waiting for your merge, so no assent yet). The "note_for callback" choice named in the srs-rust#1720 quorum comment has no decision record in the group log; it is only in the PR's decisions block.

3. Done: 14 group PRs merged this cycle, all merged by you (the-greenman). Quorum lines (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- srs-rust#1724: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / ba478783 (approve)
- srs-rust#1725: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / e36be60a (approve)
- srs-rust#1727: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / 7753b32f (approve)
- srs-rust#1720: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / ADR-037 + 0b1c25b1 (approve)
- srs#1021: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / R1 + RFC-005 (approve)
- srs#1052: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / 773ae4a6 + de6b88c5 (approve)
- srs#1033, #1034, #1036, #1037, #1035: Door 3 revisions, escalated by the reviewer under gate:owner-merge, then merged by you (no approval quorum by design)
- srs-rust#1646 (mandate 83b841f1) and srs-rust#1709 (mandate 239a1705): the reviewer's last quorum was reject (red Test gate on the head it judged); merged by you anyway.
- srs#1049 (mandate RFC-038 [R15]): the reviewer's last quorum was reject (pr-classification red, merge conflict); merged by you anyway.

4. Stuck or lost: 1 open group PR: srs-rust#1716 (gate:owner-merge, waits for you). No red gate was reported by a run since the merges. Three merged PRs (srs-rust#1646, #1709, srs#1049) carry a final reviewer verdict of reject, so the quorum comment does not match the merge; the follow-ups the reviewer asked for (docs regeneration, surface test count, classification line) are unconfirmed. Needs-input: srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, #728; srs-web#691. Blocked: srs-rust#1679, #1496; srs#1041, #1027, #928. Escalation-log check (owner rulings in both logs): not re-read this cycle.
Note: this run started at 11:33, three minutes after the close, so `group-state` and `measure` read a window beginning 11:30 today and show 0; the figures above were gathered by hand from the merged-PR lists for 2026-11-27 11:30 to 2026-11-28 11:30.

5. Budget: 14 merged PRs this cycle, all by the owner, so 0 of 10 count as delegated merges (the clerk reads 0 merged + 0 open of 10 for the window that began at 11:30 today); 1 open; room 10. Pause state: running (the last three reports were acknowledged with a 👍).
5b. Awaiting ratification: 7ee9eaf7 (proposed, depends on srs-rust#1716 merging). Nothing else from the group. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready open issues: srs-rust 7, srs 3, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0 (11 by label; 7 are blocked or need input). Workable now: srs-rust#1638 (dataModelRevision 12 support, P2). Top 3 in Builder order: srs-rust#1638, then srs-rust#1679 and srs#1041 once unblocked. Local priorities: none. Open group PRs in flight: 1; budget left 10. Queue running dry: about 1 workable, budget 10. Needs feeding: the conformance probe of unprobed invariants and the spec-to-implementation drift list. Waits on the owner: srs-rust#1716 and the review of the three merged-on-reject PRs. Fed by the analyst: last Queue fed comment 2026-11-26 (filed 0, 2 workable).
6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: I1 for this run: 0/0 grounded to a problem (n/a); record 80c692d3-44cb-4f6f-832d-a253181e3c6d. Note that its window is the three minutes after the close, so it measures nothing; the useful/noisy/misleading line is yours to give in a session, evaluator stays pending. I2 to I4: pending. The concept held where it counts: the owner cleared 14 PRs in one cycle once a day of review landed, ending the 13-day stall. What did not hold: the reviewer's reject and the owner's merge disagree on three PRs, so a quorum comment is not a reliable merge record. Build trigger: about 22 ratified decisions are in the group log, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is ready to unpark.
